Question about shot after chemo
Patient: Cordelia Vantongeren
Imogen Vantongeren (Proxy)
Nov 5, 2026 7:48 PM

Hi, this is Cordelia's daughter Imogen. Mom got her Neulasta on-body injector Tuesday and now has bad bone pain in her back. Can someone call me at 508-555-0147? My husband Rafferty can also pick up if I am at work.

Infusion Nurse Triage Pool
Nov 6, 2026 9:02 AM

Hi Imogen, thanks for reaching out. Bone pain is common after Neulasta. She can take loratadine 10 mg once daily for 5 days. Please call 24/7 if temp is 100.4 F or higher.

Cordelia Vantongeren
Nov 6, 2026 10:15 AM

Thank you. Feeling a little better today.
